list.description: The Gamma function is a generalization of the factorial function to non-integer numbers. It is often used in probability and statistics, as it shows up in the normalizing constants of important probability distributions such as the Chi-square and the Gamma.

list.title: min

list.description:
Transpile an arithmetic expression into a JavaScript program asynchronically

  • Parses the code to an AST
  • Finds the used functions
  • Generates the output code
  • Writes the output code to the output file
